# monotaur_role_assignment (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur role assignment. A role assignment binds a role to a service account, granting the service account all permissions defined by the role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_service_account" "ci_bot" {
  name = "ci-bot"
}

resource "monotaur_role" "monitor_editor" {
  name = "monitor-editor"
  permissions = [
    "monitors:read",
    "monitors:create",
    "monitors:update",
  ]
}

resource "monotaur_role_assignment" "ci_bot_editor" {
  service_account_id = monotaur_service_account.ci_bot.id
  role_id            = monotaur_role.monitor_editor.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role to assign.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the service account to assign the role to.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the role was assigned (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the role assignment (assigned by the API).
